multiset_meaning: A collection where order does not matter and duplicate elements are allowed. Only the frequency of each element matters.
when_to_use: Arrays can be rearranged freely (internal swaps are free)
Goal is to make two arrays identical or balanced
Problem depends on element counts rather than positions
core_ideas: Compute total frequency of each value
If any total frequency is odd → impossible
Find extra elements in each array
Each swap fixes two misplaced elements
key_invariant: Total extras in nums1 must equal total extras in nums2
